title: ಕುಮಾರವ್ಯಾಸ ಭಾರತ — ಆದಿಪರ್ವ
author: ಕುಮಾರವ್ಯಾಸ
description: ಗದುಗಿನ ನಾರಣಪ್ಪ 'ಕುಮಾರವ್ಯಾಸ'ನ ಕರ್ಣಾಟ ಭಾರತ ಕಥಾಮಂಜರಿಯ ಆದಿಪರ್ವದ ಮೊದಲ ಎಂಟು ಸಂಧಿಗಳು — ಭಾಮಿನೀ ಷಟ್ಪದಿಯ ೪೦೪ ಪದ್ಯಗಳು. ಪೀಠಿಕೆಯ ದೇವತಾಸ್ತುತಿಯಿಂದ ತೊಡಗಿ ಜನಮೇಜಯನ ಸರ್ಪಯಾಗ, ಕುರುವಂಶದ ಉಗಮ, ಕರ್ಣ-ಪಾಂಡವ-ಕೌರವರ ಜನನ, ಪಾಂಡುವಿನ ಮರಣ, ದ್ರೋಣಾಚಾರ್ಯರ ಶಸ್ತ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅರಗಿನ ಮನೆಯವರೆಗಿನ ಕಥೆ.

provenance.licenseNote: Kumaravyasa (ಕುಮಾರವ್ಯಾಸ, Naranappa of Gadag) died c. 1430 CE; the text is public domain worldwide. Taken from the Kannada Wikisource edition of ಕರ್ಣಾಟ ಭಾರತ ಕಥಾಮಂಜರಿ: the ಆದಿಪರ್ವ index page above links one page per sandhi; the exact pages used (sandhis 1–8) are listed in sources.txt beside this file. Wikisource cites as its printed source the Mysore Govt. Dept. of Literature & Culture edition (ed. Masti Venkatesha Iyengar) and marks it ಕಾಪಿರೈಟ್ ಮುಕ್ತ (copyright-free). Only the verses and each sandhi's ಸೂಚನೆ were taken: the Sanskrit invocations, editors' variant-reading notes '(ಪಾ: …)', glosses, and navigation text were dropped. Obvious typing errors were corrected against the parallel Wikisource ಸಟೀಕಾ pages of the same verses (their modern commentary was not used); every such change is recorded in sources.txt.
